title: Nitrogen Generator - NITROJET
description: Easy to convert ordinary digital tyre inflator to digital nitrogen tyre inflator using this module.
subtitle: For Tyre Inflation
fullDescription: Nitrogen generator module that makes it easy to convert ordinary digital tyre inflator to digital nitrogen tyre inflator. Features reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation, air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine, pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off, and wheel base option is available to move to desired location.
features: Easy to convert ordinary digital tyre inflator to digital nitrogen tyre inflator using this module
Computer power chord adapter with fuse protection and switch on indicator
Pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off
Pressure gauge for input air pressure indication and internal tank nitrogen pressure indication
Safety pressure relief valve available for internal tank
Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation
Air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine
Wheel base option is available to move to desired location
Suitable for inflators used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck

specifications.pressureGauge: Two Pressure Gauge Indication, one for Input Air Pressure and other for Stored Nitrogen Pressure
specifications.functionalKeys: Membrane keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.overPressureSafety: Pressure switch with automatic on - off setting
